emma beko.bio: Montréal artist Emma Beko makes emotionally raw alternative hip-hop shaped by grunge influences, a multicultural upbringing and her earlier years in the duo Heartstreets.

eva shaw.bio: Toronto-born DJ, songwriter and producer Eva Shaw has built a Canadian catalogue spanning electronic music, hip-hop production and artist collaborations.

fouki.bio: Montréal rapper FouKi, born Léo Fougères, makes playful, highly collaborative francophone hip-hop shaped by reggae and a wide range of Québec musical influences.

freak heat waves.bio: Canadian duo Freak Heat Waves emerged from Medicine Hat and built an underground catalogue that moves between post-punk, dub and experimental electronic music.

grandtheft.bio: Toronto producer and DJ Grandtheft, born Aaron Waisglass, makes club-focused electronic music informed by hip-hop, dancehall and bass-heavy production.

ian kamau.bio: Toronto artist Ian Kamau uses hip-hop and multidisciplinary storytelling to explore family, identity, memory and community across music, writing and visual work.

jahkoy.bio: Toronto-born singer, rapper and songwriter JAHKOY makes contemporary R&B with pop and hip-hop influences, building on a career that began when he was a teenage rapper.

joey stylez.bio: Saskatchewan First Nations-Métis singer and rapper Joey Stylez brings hip-hop together with pop and country influences while mentoring Indigenous artists and supporting youth communities.
